scope: Selected and fetched the most Strata-like feature-complete DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash engine baseline with DSpark speculative decoding. Source and tiny artifact metadata only; no engine build, model download, model run, B550 restart, or Optane change was made.

selection.verdict: selected as the architecture and implementation baseline
reason: Native deepseek41 loader and execution graph
DSpark three-stage speculative head, adaptive width, rollback, and fused verify
CSA2 compressed sparse attention and Engram implementation
Three-tier expert ownership across primary GPU, secondary GPU/host, and SSD
Router bias, protected experts, placement files, prefetch, and streamed expert slot cache
Paged concurrent serving and prefix-cache work
Active upstream and permissive Apache-2.0 licensing

alternatives.vLLM: Most complete mainstream production path and also Apache-2.0, but its V4.1 Engram offload is pinned-host oriented rather than the desired consumer SSD expert tier.
alternatives.SGLang: Native and Apache-2.0 with DSpark, but less focused on consumer heterogeneous expert streaming.
alternatives.JigSawPT llama.cpp fork: Close measured single-RTX-5090 SSD tier, but a narrower research fork/report than Lucebox.
alternatives.DS41RT: Native DSpark service, but targets RTX PRO 6000 plus four DGX Spark workers and lacks the same SSD expert-owner design.
